description: This bar chart illustrates the performance scores of a model, LLaMA-3-8B-it, across several academic and practical benchmarks. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset and Metrics,” lists the benchmark names: eSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC_AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, displayed in a fixed order. The vertical axis, labeled “Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Two bars are present for each benchmark, colored blue and orange, representing the model’s score. For eSM-8K, the blue bar reaches approximately 76% while the orange bar reaches approximately 63%. The shortest bars are observed for Chat-Arena-Hard, with the blue bar at approximately 58% and the orange bar at approximately 60%. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each benchmark, with no visual emphasis applied to any specific bar.
